```python import json import re import pytest from youtube_dl.extractor.itv import ITVIE from youtube_dl.utils import determine_ext, parse_duration, clean_html # Helper subclass that injects controlled responses class DummyITVIE(ITVIE): def __init__(self, webpage, playlist_json): super().__init__(downloader=None) self._webpage = webpage self._playlist_json = playlist_json def _download_webpage(self, url, video_id): return self._webpage def _download_json(self, url, video_id, data=None, headers=None): return self._playlist_json # Sample webpage and playlist data for normal extraction sample_webpage = """
This is a description.
""" sample_playlist = { "Playlist": { "Video": { "Base": "https://cdn.itv.com/", "MediaFiles": [ {"Href": "/video1.mp4"}, {"Href": "/video2.m3u8"} ], "Subtitles": [ {"Href": "https://cdn.itv.com/subs_en.vtt"} ], "Duration": "PT1H30M" } } } def test_itvie_normal_extraction(): ie = DummyITVIE(sample_webpage, sample_playlist) result = ie._real_extract("https://www.itv.com/hub/liar/2a4547a0012") assert result["id"] == "2a4547a0012" assert result["title"] == "Liar - Series 2 - Episode 6" assert result["description"] == "This is a description." assert result["duration"] == parse_duration("PT1H30M") # formats should include both mp4 and m3u8 formats = result["formats"] assert any(f["url"] == "https://cdn.itv.com/video1.mp4" for f in formats) assert any(f["url"].startswith("https://cdn.itv.com/video2.m3u8") for f in formats) # subtitles subs = result["subtitles"] assert "en" in subs assert subs["en"][0]["url"] == "https://cdn.itv.com/subs_en.vtt" def test_itvie_no_media_files(): # Playlist with no MediaFiles playlist_no_media = { "Playlist": { "Video": { "Base": "https://cdn.itv.com/", "MediaFiles": [], "Subtitles": [], "Duration": "PT0M" } } } ie = DummyITVIE(sample_webpage, playlist_no_media) result = ie._real_extract("https://www.itv.com/hub/liar/2a4547a0012") assert result["formats"] == [] # no formats assert result["subtitles"] == {} # no subtitles assert result["duration"] == 0 def test_itvie_invalid_json_raises(): # Simulate invalid JSON by returning a string instead of dict class BadJSONDummyITVIE(DummyITVIE): def _download_json(self, url, video_id, data=None, headers=None): return "not a dict" ie = BadJSONDummyITVIE(sample_webpage, "not a dict") with pytest.raises(TypeError): ie._real_extract("https://www.itv.com/hub/liar/2a4547a0012") ```
